examples.text: In full consideration for all services rendered and rights granted hereunder, Amazon shall pay ProdCo the Production Fee in accordance with the payment schedule set forth in Exhibit D. The Production Fee shall constitute the entire compensation payable to ProdCo unless otherwise expressly provided.
examples.notes: Core production fee provision with full consideration language

examples.text: ProdCo may be entitled to contingent compensation based on Net Receipts as set forth in Exhibit C, subject to Amazon's standard accounting practices and definitions. Contingent compensation, if any, shall be calculated and paid semi-annually.
ProdCo shall be solely responsible for all taxes arising from payments received under this Agreement. ProdCo acknowledges that it is an independent contractor and not an employee of Amazon.
examples.notes: Tax responsibility - lower confidence, consider GeneralProvisions if isolated

examples.text: The Production Fee shall be payable in installments as follows: (a) Twenty percent (20%) upon execution of this Agreement; (b) Thirty percent (30%) upon commencement of principal photography; (c) Thirty percent (30%) upon completion of principal photography; (d) Twenty percent (20%) upon delivery and acceptance of the final cut.
Amazon shall pay ProdCo a backend participation equal to five percent (5%) of Net Receipts after recoupment of the Production Fee and distribution expenses as defined in Exhibit C.
In addition to the Production Fee, Amazon shall reimburse ProdCo for pre-approved out-of-pocket production expenses in accordance with the approved budget attached as Exhibit F.

All payments shall be made within thirty (30) days of ProdCo's submission of a proper invoice together with documentation required by Amazon. Late payments shall accrue interest at the rate of one percent (1%) per month.
examples.notes: Payment mechanics and late payment interest

examples.text: If the Program receives an Academy Award nomination in any category, Amazon shall pay ProdCo a bonus of One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($100,000). If the Program wins an Academy Award, Amazon shall pay an additional bonus of Two Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($250,000).

negative_examples.text: Upon termination for convenience, Amazon shall pay ProdCo for services rendered and costs properly incurred through the termination date.
negative_examples.why_not_payment: Payment occurs only in context of termination consequences, not ongoing compensation obligation

negative_examples.text: ProdCo shall indemnify Amazon for all costs, including attorneys' fees, arising from any breach.
negative_examples.why_not_payment: Costs are indemnification-related, not Amazon's payment to ProdCo

negative_examples.text: ProdCo shall obtain insurance with premiums paid by ProdCo as a production cost.
negative_examples.why_not_payment: Premium payment is part of insurance requirement, not compensation
